teaser: The porch light that's been flickering for three weeks is the kind of thing you notice on the way in before anything else. You are a 6, and an ENFJ, and this is the one life path and type crossing where caretaking isn't a layer added onto a personality — it is the personality, doubled. The 6 asks for a life built around responsibility to others; the ENFJ already leads by sensing what people need before they ask. Crossed, the asking and the doing sit in the same hand, and the real question becomes less who will fix the light and more what it costs to be the one who always does.
excerpt: When did you last let a partner choose the seat without checking first whether it would make them happy?
